title: What's a Ten-Bagger?
content:
People always ask me about 'ten-baggers.' It's a baseball term—a batter who gets to third base is a three-bagger. But in stocks? A ten-bagger is a stock that goes up 10x.

Now here's the thing—you don't need to find many. When we backtested portfolios at the shop, the pattern was always the same. Most holdings did okay. Some lost money. But a handful of big winners carried the whole thing. They paid for all the mistakes and then some.

My first one was that drill maker, bought with hardware-store wages when I was a kid. I didn't know what I was doing. But the math of it stuck with me.

That's why I say—you only need a few good ideas. You don't need to be right every time. You just need to let your winners run, and be honest about your losers.
